# Clean Document

This document follows model neutrality guidelines.

## AI Configuration

Use the `.ai/` directory for AI-related configuration files.
The `.airules` file contains project-specific AI instructions.
The `.aiignore` file specifies files to exclude from AI processing.

## Development Guidelines

When using AI assistants for development, follow these guidelines:

1. Use generic references to AI systems
2. Avoid mentioning specific AI providers
3. Keep configuration files provider-neutral

This file is compliant and should pass all checks.
